       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. HCFGPROG.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-GREETING PIC X(16) VALUE "CONFIG LOADER".
       01 WS-CFG.
          05 WS-CFG-01 PIC X(167) VALUE
              X"".
       01 WS-LEN PIC 9(4) VALUE 167.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY WS-GREETING.
           DISPLAY WS-CFG(1:4) " " WS-LEN.
           STOP RUN.
